options.name: ackqueue
options.description: The name of the traffic shaper queue to assume as the ACK queue for ACK traffic matching this rule.

options.name: api_host
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the pfSense device.

options.name: api_key
options.description: An API key to use for authentication.

options.name: api_password
options.description: The password to authenticate with the pfSense API.

options.name: api_port
options.description: The port number of the pfSense API.

options.name: api_protocol
options.description: The protocol to use when connecting to the pfSense API.

options.name: api_username
options.description: The username to authenticate with the pfSense API.

options.name: defaultqueue
options.description: The name of the traffic shaper queue to assume as the default queue for traffic matching this rule.

options.name: descr
options.description: A description detailing the purpose or justification of this firewall rule.

options.name: destination
options.description: The destination address this rule applies to. Valid value options are: an existing interface, an IP address, a subnet CIDR, an existing alias, `any`, `(self)`, `l2tp`, `pppoe`. The context of this address can be inverted by prefixing the value with `!`. For interface values, the `:ip` modifier can be appended to the value to use the interface's IP address instead of its entire subnet.

options.name: destination_port
options.description: The destination port this rule applies to. Set to `null` to allow any destination port. Valid options are: a TCP/UDP port number, a TCP/UDP port range separated by `:`, an existing port type firewall alias

options.name: direction
options.description: The direction of traffic this firewall rule applies to. This field only applies to floating firewall rules.

options.name: disabled
options.description: Enable or disable this firewall rule.

options.name: dnpipe
options.description: The name of the traffic shaper limiter pipe or queue to use for incoming traffic.

options.name: dscp
options.description: The DSCP value this firewall rule should match.

options.name: floating
options.description: Mark this rule as a floating firewall rule.

options.name: gateway
options.description: The gateway traffic matching this rule will be routed to. Set to `null` to use default.

options.name: icmptype
options.description: Th ICMP subtypes this rule applies to. This field is only applicable when `ipprotocol` is `inet` and `protocol` is `icmp`.

options.name: interface
options.description: The interface where packets must originate to match this rule.

options.name: ipprotocol
options.description: The IP version(s) this rule applies to.

options.name: log
options.description: Enable or disable logging of traffic that matches this rule.

options.name: lookup_fields
options.description: The list of fields to use when looking up existing resources. This should be a list of field names that uniquely identify a resource.

options.name: pdnpipe
options.description: The name of the traffic shaper limiter pipe or queue to use for outgoing traffic.

options.name: protocol
options.description: The IP/transport protocol this rule should match.

options.name: quick
options.description: Apply this action to traffic that matches this rule immediately. This field only applies to floating firewall rules.

options.name: sched
options.description: The name of an existing firewall schedule to assign to this firewall rule.

options.name: source
options.description: The source address this rule applies to. Valid value options are: an existing interface, an IP address, a subnet CIDR, an existing alias, `any`, `(self)`, `l2tp`, `pppoe`. The context of this address can be inverted by prefixing the value with `!`. For interface values, the `:ip` modifier can be appended to the value to use the interface's IP address instead of its entire subnet.

options.name: source_port
options.description: The source port this rule applies to. Set to `null` to allow any source port. Valid options are: a TCP/UDP port number, a TCP/UDP port range separated by `:`, an existing port type firewall alias

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the resource should be present or absent.

options.name: statetype
options.description: The state mechanism to use for this firewall rule.

options.name: tag
options.description: A packet matching this rule can be marked and this mark used to match on other NAT/filter rules. It is called

options.name: tcp_flags_any
options.description: Allow any TCP flags.

options.name: tcp_flags_out_of
options.description: The TCP flags that can be set for this rule to match.

options.name: tcp_flags_set
options.description: The TCP flags that must be set for this rule to match.

options.name: type
options.description: The action to take against traffic that matches this rule.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether to validate SSL certificates when connecting to the API.
